Founded in 1957, the team's best period was between 2011 and 2019, when it amassed eight participations in the highest tier of the [[Romanian football league system|Romanian league system]], the [[Liga I]]. Concordia was also runner-up of the short-lived [[Cupa Ligii]] in the [[2015–16 Cupa Ligii|2015–16 campaign]]. The club plays its home matches on the namesake [[Stadionul Concordia]], which has [[artificial turf]] and can hold 5,123 persons."}}
